54165-ariosto-shakespeare-and-corneille.creator: Unknown
54165-ariosto-shakespeare-and-corneille.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. all criticism is based upon philosophy, and that therefore if the philosophy upon which it is based is unsound, the criticism suffers accordingly. Croce has elsewhere shown that the shortcomings of such critics as Sainte-Beuve, Taine, Lemaître and Brunetière are due to incorrect or insufficient philosophical knowledge and a similar criterion can be applied at home with equal truth.

61348-life-of-edwin-forrest-the-american.creator: William Rounseville Alger.
61348-life-of-edwin-forrest-the-american.description: A book by William Rounseville Alger.. ating no revolutionary one except from a sense of duty and in the hope of doing a service, he will calmly accept whatever odium the firm statement of his honest convictions may bring. Society in the present phase of civilization is full of tyrannical errors and wrongs against which most persons are afraid even so much as to whisper.

8079-pamela-giraud-a-play-in-five-acts.title: Pamela Giraud A Play In Five Acts
8079-pamela-giraud-a-play-in-five-acts.creator: Honore de Balzac
8079-pamela-giraud-a-play-in-five-acts.description: A book by Honore de Balzac. Why should I, senior apprentice with M. Morel, instead of   aiming at setting up business for myself, fall in love with this young   lady? It certainly hinders me in my career; and yet I   dream of her--I am infatuated with her. Suppose my uncle knew it!--But   she is not the only woman in Paris, and, after all, Mlle.

arxiv-2202-09883.title: On Efficient Noncommutative Polynomial Factorization via Higman Linearization Thanks: A preliminary version was presented at the 37th Computational Complexity Conference, CCC’22, [ AJ22 ] .
arxiv-2202-09883.creator: V. Arvind, Pushkar S Joglekar
arxiv-2202-09883.description: Abstract In this paper we study the problem of efficiently factorizing polynomials in the free noncommutative ring 𝔽 ⁡ ⟨ x 1 , x 2 , … , x n ⟩ \mathbb{F}\langle x_{1},x_{2},\ldots,x_{n}\rangle of polynomials in noncommuting variables x 1 , x 2 , … , x n x_{1},x_{2},\ldots,x_{n} over the field 𝔽 \mathbb{F} .

arxiv-2202-10409.title: Observation of anisotropic thermal expansion and Jahn-Teller effect in double perovskites Sr 2-x La x CoNbO 6 using neutron diffraction
arxiv-2202-10409.creator: Ajay Kumar, Anil Jain, S. M. Yusuf, R. S. Dhaka
arxiv-2202-10409.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Ajay Kumar, Anil Jain, S. M. Yusuf, R. S. Dhaka. We use temperature dependent neutron powder diffraction (NPD) to investigate the structural changes and magnetic interactions in double perovskite Sr 2-x La x CoNbO 6 ( x = x= 0.4 and 0.6). A structural phase transition from tetragonal ( I ​ 4 / m I4/m ) to monoclinic ( P ​ 2 1 / n P2_{1}/n ) is observed between x = x= 0.4 and 0.6 samples.

arxiv-2204-13802.title: BILP-Q: Quantum Coalition Structure Generation
arxiv-2204-13802.creator: Supreeth Mysore Venkatesh, Antonio Macaluso, Matthias Klusch
arxiv-2204-13802.description: Abstract Quantum AI is an emerging field that uses quantum computing to solve typical complex problems in AI. In this work, we propose BILP-Q, the first-ever general quantum approach for solving the Coalition Structure Generation problem (CSGP), which is notably NP-hard.

arxiv-2205-06467.title: Extinction of multiple shocks in the modular Burgers’ equation
arxiv-2205-06467.creator: Dmitry E. Pelinovsky, Björn de Rijk
arxiv-2205-06467.description: Abstract . We consider multiple shock waves in the Burgers’ equation with a modular advection term. It was previously shown that the modular Burgers’ equation admits a traveling viscous shock with a single interface, which is stable against smooth and exponentially localized perturbations.

arxiv-2311-12086.title: Masked Autoencoders Are Robust Neural Architecture Search Learners
arxiv-2311-12086.creator: Yiming Hu, Xiangxiang Chu Meituan {huyiming03,chuxiangxiang,zhangbo97}@meituan.com Bo Zhang
arxiv-2311-12086.description: Abstract Neural Architecture Search (NAS) currently relies heavily on labeled data, which is both expensive and time-consuming to acquire. In this paper, we propose a novel NAS framework based on Masked Autoencoders (MAE) that eliminates the need for labeled data during the search process.

arxiv-2311-13210.title: b → s ​ γ b\to s\gamma , electron EDM and electroweak baryogenesis: a study in general 2HDM
arxiv-2311-13210.creator: George Wei-Shu Hou
arxiv-2311-13210.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by George Wei-Shu Hou. We study inclusive b → s ​ γ b\to s\gamma decay in the context of electron EDM and baryogenesis. The general 2HDM (i.e. without Z 2 Z_{2} ) that possesses an extra set of Yukawa matrices can drive electroweak baryogensis via λ t ​ Im ​ ρ t ​ t \lambda_{t}{\rm Im}\rho_{tt} , where ρ t ​ t \rho_{tt} is the extra diagonal top Yukawa coupling, with the e e EDM constraint evaded by an exquisite flavor cancellation mechanism.

arxiv-2312-04554.title: Improved Visual Grounding through Self-Consistent Explanations
arxiv-2312-04554.creator: Ruozhen He, Paola Cascante-Bonilla, Ziyan Yang, Alexander C. Berg, Vicente Ordonez
arxiv-2312-04554.description: Abstract Vision-and-language models trained to match images with text can be combined with visual explanation methods to point to the locations of specific objects in an image. Our work shows that the localization –“grounding”– abilities of these models can be further improved by finetuning for self-consistent visual explanations.

arxiv-2401-01701.title: De-Hallucinator: Mitigating LLM Hallucinations in Code Generation Tasks via Iterative Grounding
arxiv-2401-01701.creator: Aryaz Eghbali, Michael Pradel
arxiv-2401-01701.description: Abstract . Large language models (LLMs) trained on datasets of publicly available source code have established a new state of the art in code generation tasks. However, these models are mostly unaware of the code that exists within a specific project, preventing the models from making good use of existing APIs.

arxiv-2405-07123.title: CANA v1.0.0 and schematodes: efficient quantification of symmetry in Boolean automata
arxiv-2405-07123.creator: Austin M. Marcus \ORCID 0000-0002-1611-8236, Jordan Rozum \ORCID 0000-0002-4356-9809, Herbert Sizek \ORCID 0000-0003-0199-6965, Luis M. Rocha \ORCID 0000-0001-9402-887X
arxiv-2405-07123.description: Abstract The biomolecular networks underpinning cell function exhibit canalization, or the buffering of fluctuations required to function in a noisy environment. One understudied putative mechanism for canalization is the functional equivalence of a biomolecular entity’s regulators (e.g., among the transcription factors for a gene). We use Boolean networks to study cell regulatory systems.

arxiv-2410-20218.title: Reflectionless Dirac operators and canonical systems Thanks: 2020 Mathematics Subject Classification. 34B20 34L40 81Q10
arxiv-2410-20218.creator: Christian Remling, Jie Zeng
arxiv-2410-20218.description: Abstract . We study canonical systems that are reflectionless on an open set. In this situation, the two half line m m functions are holomorphic continuations of each other and may thus be combined into a single holomorphic function. This idea was explored in [ 11 ] , and we continue these investigations here.

arxiv-2411-07119.title: The Two-Dimensional Rashba-Holstein Model: A Quantum Monte Carlo Approach
arxiv-2411-07119.creator: Julián Faúndez, Rodrigo A. Fontenele, S. dos A. Sousa-Júnior, Fakher F. Assaad, Natanael C. Costa
arxiv-2411-07119.description: Abstract In this work, we investigate the impact of Rashba spin-orbit coupling (RSOC) on the formation of charge-density wave (CDW) and superconducting (SC) phases in the Holstein model on a half-filled square lattice. Using unbiased finite-temperature Quantum Monte Carlo simulations, we go beyond mean-field approaches to determine the ground state order parameter as a function of RSOC and phonon frequency.

arxiv-2507-02273.title: Fx-Encoder++: Extracting Instrument-Wise Audio Effects Representations from Mixtures
arxiv-2507-02273.description: Abstract General-purpose audio representations have proven effective across diverse music information retrieval applications, yet their utility in intelligent music production remains limited by insufficient understanding of audio effects (Fx). Although previous approaches have emphasized audio effects analysis at the mixture level, this focus falls short for tasks demanding instrument-wise audio effects understanding, such as automatic mixing.

arxiv-2509-19532.title: To Stream or Not to Stream: Towards A Quantitative Model for Remote HPC Processing Decisions Conference: Workshops of the International Conference for High Performance Computing, Networking, Storage and Analysis; November 16–21, 2025; St Louis, MO, USA Workshops of the International Conference for H
arxiv-2509-19532.creator: Flavio Castro, Weijian Zheng, Joaquin Chung, Ian Foster, and Rajkumar Kettimuthu
arxiv-2509-19532.description: Abstract . Modern scientific instruments generate data at rates that increasingly exceed local compute capabilities and, when paired with the staging and I/O overheads of file-based transfers, also render file-based use of remote HPC resources impractical for time-sensitive analysis and experimental steering.

arxiv-2510-14331.title: LLM-ERM: Sample-Efficient Program Learning via LLM-Guided Search
arxiv-2510-14331.creator: Shivam Singhal, Eran Malach, Tomaso Poggio, Tomer Galanti
arxiv-2510-14331.description: Abstract We seek algorithms for program learning that are both sample-efficient and computationally feasible. Classical results show that targets admitting short program descriptions (e.g., with short “python code”) can be learned with a “small” number of examples (scaling with the size of the code) via length-first program enumeration, but the search is exponential in description length.

arxiv-2511-04450.title: Solving Convex Partition Visual Jigsaw Puzzles
arxiv-2511-04450.creator: Yaniv Ohayon 1 , Ofir Itzhak Shahar 1 , and Ohad Ben-Shahar 1 1 Ben-Gurion University of the Negev, Beer-Sheva, Israel yanivoha@post.bgu.ac.il, shofir@post.bgu.ac.il, obs@bgu.ac.il
arxiv-2511-04450.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Yaniv Ohayon 1 , Ofir Itzhak Shahar 1 , and Ohad Ben-Shahar 1 1 Ben-Gurion University of the Negev, Beer-Sheva, Israel yanivoha@post.bgu.ac.il, shofir@post.bgu.ac.il, obs@bgu.ac.il. Jigsaw puzzle solving requires the rearrangement of unordered pieces into their original pose in order to reconstruct a coherent whole, often an image, and is known to be an intractable problem.

arxiv-2602-13732.title: Unbounded Reinhardt domains with finite-dimensional Bergman spaces in ℂ n {\mathbb{C}}^{n}
arxiv-2602-13732.creator: Chika Hayashida and Joe Kamimoto
arxiv-2602-13732.description: Abstract . In this paper, we construct unbounded domains in ℂ n {\mathbb{C}}^{n} ( n ≥ 2 n\geq 2 ), whose Bergman spaces are nontrivial and finite-dimensional. We further show that the Bergman metrics on these domains have positive constant sectional curvature equal to 2 2 , and that their holomorphic automorphism groups consist only of linear mappings.

arxiv-2605-03796.title: Capability centrality: the next step from scale-free property
arxiv-2605-03796.creator: Mikhail Tuzhilin 1

pmc-10538174.title: Bioactivity-Guided Synthesis: In Silico and In Vitro Studies of β-Glucosidase Inhibitors to Cope with Hepatic Cytotoxicity
pmc-10538174.creator: Aneela Khushal, Umar Farooq, Sara Khan, Azhar Rasul, Tanveer A Wani, Seema Zargar, Sohail Anjum Shahzad, Syed Majid Bukhari, Nazeer Ahmad Khan, Anna Maria Almerico
pmc-10538174.description: The major cause of hyperglycemia can generally be attributed to β-glucosidase as per its involvement in non-alcoholic fatty liver disease. This clinical condition leads to liver carcinoma (HepG2 cancer). The phthalimides and phthalamic acid classes possess inhibitory potential against glucosidase, forming the basis for designing new phthalimide and phthalamic acid analogs to test their ability as potent inhibitors of β-glucosidase.

pmc-10540601.title: Autologous haematopoietic stem cell transplantation for multiple sclerosis: a position paper and registry outline
pmc-10540601.creator: Antonios Bayas, Achim Berthele, Norbert Blank, Peter Dreger, Simon Faissner, Manuel A Friese, Lisa-Ann Gerdes, Oliver Martin Grauer, Vivien Häussler, Christoph Heesen, Dietlinde Janson, Mirjam Korporal-Kuhnke, Markus Kowarik, Nikolaus Kröger, Jan D Lünemann, Roland Martin, Uwe Meier, Sven Meuth, Pao
pmc-10540601.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Background:While substantial progress has been made in the development of disease-modifying medications for multiple sclerosis (MS), a high percentage of treated patients still show progression and persistent inflammatory activity. Autologous haematopoietic stem cell transplantation (AHSCT) aims at eliminating a pathogenic immune repertoire through intense short-term immunosuppression that enables subsequent regeneration of a new and healthy immune system to re-establish immune tolerance for a long period of time.

pmc-10753953.title: Psychological risk factors for Long COVID and their modification: study protocol of a three-arm, randomised controlled trial (SOMA.COV)
pmc-10753953.creator: Petra Engelmann, Christian Büchel, Jördis Frommhold, Hans F. E. Klose, Ansgar W. Lohse, Kerstin Maehder, Yvonne Nestoriuc, Martin Scherer, Anna Suling, Anne Toussaint, Angelika Weigel, Antonia Zapf, Bernd Löwe
pmc-10753953.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). BackgroundGrowing evidence suggests that in addition to pathophysiological, there are psychological risk factors involved in the development of Long COVID. Illness-related anxiety and dysfunctional symptom expectations seem to contribute to symptom persistence.AimsWith regard to the development of effective therapies, our primary aim is to investigate whether symptoms of Long COVID can be improved by a targeted modification of illness-related anxiety and dysfunctional symptom expectations.

pmc-11536744.title: Effects of dietary black cumin (Nigella sativa L.) meal on performance, blood metabolites, and digestibility in a rice straw-based diet of fattening Garut lambs
pmc-11536744.creator: Diky Ramdani, Karina Natasya Juandita, Iman Hernaman, Ken Ratu Gharizah Alhuur
pmc-11536744.description: Background and Aim:During black cumin oil production, black cumin meal (BCM) is produced as a by-product. This study investigated the potential use of BCM to partly replace concentrate in a rice straw-based diet of fattening Garut lambs.Materials and Methods:Twenty-eight heads of male Garut lambs aged approximately10 months with an average initial body weight of 20.7 kg/head (coefficient of variation 12.

pmc-11648753.title: Exploring the role of geothermal energy consumption in achieving carbon neutrality and environmental sustainability
pmc-11648753.creator: Ghalieb Mutig Idroes, Mohd Afjal, Mohsin Khan, Mohammad Haseeb, Irsan Hardi, Teuku Rizky Noviandy, Rinaldi Idroes
pmc-11648753.description: While there is extensive research on the environmental impacts of renewable energy sources, a notable gap remains in understanding the specific environmental effects of geothermal energy. This knowledge shortfall is particularly critical for Indonesia, which holds the world's second-largest geothermal potential but has yet to effectively harness these valuable resources.

pmc-11692314.title: A CROSS-NATIONAL COMPARISON OF THE EFFECT OF SMOKING AND DRINKING BEHAVIOR ON COGNITIVE HEALTH IN TAIWAN AND THE US
pmc-11692314.creator: Yan-Jhu Su, Yao-Chi Shih
pmc-11692314.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Previous studies have shown that smoking tobacco and alcohol consumption impact individuals’ cognitive health. However, less studies have focused on cross-national comparisons of the effects of smoking and alcohol consumption on cognitive health and their differential effects across gender. This cross-sectional study used the Health and Retirement Study (HRS) 2018 (N= 7,467) and the Taiwan Longitudinal Study in Aging (TLSA) 2019 (N=2,776) for comparison. The cognitive function scores of the HRS are from the Telephone Interview of Cognitive Status-Modified (TICS-M; range: 0-35).

pmc-11860933.title: Evaluation of an App-based brief Cognitive Behavioral Therapy for individuals with Nonsuicidal Self-injury
pmc-11860933.creator: S Kang, S M Zoh, J-W Hur
pmc-11860933.description: IntroductionNonsuicidal self-injury (NSSI), the deliberate and direct destruction of one’s own body tissue without suicidal intent, has represented a significant public health concern among adolescents and young adults worldwide, yet they have limited access to evidence-based interventions. App-based digital therapy, with its advantages of high cost-effectiveness, accessibility, and user receptivity, could be an effective intervention for NSSI.

pmc-12442181.title: Effectiveness of visual inspection, practices observation and aerobic colony count to monitor hospital cleanliness
pmc-12442181.creator: Ying-Chun Chen, Pei-Yi Lin, Hui-Mei Huang, Zhi-Yuan Shi, Chun-Hsi Tai
pmc-12442181.description: Background: Enhancing environmental hygiene resulted in a reduction of multidrug-resistant microorganisms colonization and healthcare-associated infections. There has been less studies to compare the effects of practice observation with other methods. This study aimed to compare correlations between visual inspection, practice observation and aerobic colony count (ACC) and verify the effectiveness.

pmc-12630977.title: MRI guided HIFU robotic system application in feasibility study for treating uterine fibroids
pmc-12630977.creator: Depeng Liu, Maoyun Zhao, Xuhui Fan, Ming Li, Xiaorui Yin, Guofeng Shen, Han Wang
pmc-12630977.description: This article describes a Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) -guided High-Intensity Focused Ultrasound (HIFU) robotic system for the treatment of uterine fibroids. The study presents the development and sensor-based accuracy assessment of the robotic system. The positioning accuracy was assessed in free space using a three-dimensional coordinate measuring machine (CMM) and verified in phantom study and ex vivo with porcine tissue.

pmc-12653211.title: Diagnostic Utility of CT Findings as Indicators for Bowel Resection in Strangulated Small Bowel Obstruction
pmc-12653211.creator: Takashi Okumura, Shingo Tsujinaka, Nozomi Satani, Kuniharu Yamamoto, Toru Nakano, Takayuki Yamada, Yu Katayose, Chikashi Shibata, Roberto Cirocchi
pmc-12653211.description: Background/objectives: Strangulated small bowel obstruction (SSBO) is a life-threatening condition that often requires emergency surgery. Identifying preoperative computed tomography (CT) findings indicative of bowel resection may improve diagnostic accuracy and inform surgical decision-making. Methods: We retrospectively analyzed patients diagnosed with SSBO who underwent contrast-enhanced abdominal CT and emergency surgery between January 2022 and April 2024.

pmc-12730888.title: Thykamine™: A New Player in the Field of Anti-Inflammatory Drugs
pmc-12730888.creator: Charles Lynde, Louis Flamand, Vincent McCarty, John Sampalis
pmc-12730888.description: Background/Objectives: Persistent inflammation driven by cytokines/chemokines plays a crucial role in the pathogenesis of numerous chronic inflammatory and autoimmune conditions, including rheumatoid arthritis, atopic dermatitis, and ulcerative colitis. Current therapeutic agents often present limitations due to adverse effects. Thykamine™, a new plant-derived multi-target drug, has demonstrated promising anti-inflammatory effects and a favorable safety profile in clinical settings.

pmc-12752835.title: Outcomes in Patients Undergoing Transoral Incisionless Fundoplication With Ineffective Esophageal Motility
pmc-12752835.creator: Dhruvanshu Patel, Zarian Prenatt, Emilie S Kim, Parampreet Kaur, Amit Sohagia, Vhada S Sharma, Chandani Patel, Madhav Changela, Krutarth Shukla, Ronak Modi, Poorani Gurumallesh Prabu
pmc-12752835.description: BackgroundTransoral incisionless fundoplication (TIF) presents a minimally invasive, endoscopic treatment for the management of gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD), known for its efficacy and safety in patients with normal esophageal motility. However, the use of TIF in ineffective esophageal motility (IEM) remains largely unexplored. This study examined the outcomes of TIF in IEM patients.

pmc-13010598.title: Effects of Thickening Agents Used in Dysphagia on the In Vitro Dissolution of Gliclazide
pmc-13010598.creator: Ayman Allahham, Seerat Fatima, Ieva Stupans, Thilini Thrimawithana, Vivek B. Nooney
pmc-13010598.description: Dysphagia is common among older adults and frequently necessitates the use of thickening agents to facilitate safe swallowing of medicines, which may in turn alter their bioavailability. This study investigated the impact of two commercially available lubricants—Gloup® Forte and extremely thick water—on the in vitro dissolution behaviour of immediate-release gliclazide tablets.

pmc-13399718.title: Ginsenoside Rg1 Ameliorates LPS‐Induced Sepsis‐Associated Lung Injury in Mice via VEGFC/D‐VEGFR3 Signaling‐Mediated Lymphangiogenesis and Lymphatic Remodeling
pmc-13399718.creator: He Wang, Lan Hu, Chun‐Pan Zhang, Wen‐Jie Qi, Yu‐Guo Song
pmc-13399718.description: Sepsis‐induced acute lung injury (ALI) remains challenging to treat, with conventional anti‐inflammatory therapies offering limited efficacy. The lymphatic system is crucial for removing edema and inflammatory mediators, and its impairment can exacerbate lung injury. Ginsenoside Rg1, a bioactive botanical compound, has diverse pharmacological properties, but its ability to modulate lymphangiogenesis in septic ALI is unclear.

pmc-13551402.creator: Anton C. de Groot, Norbertus A. Ipenburg, Sylvie M. Franken, Thomas Rustemeyer

uslaw-usc-t46-s80302.title: 46 U.S.C. § 80302 — Patrol services
uslaw-usc-t46-s80302.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t46-s80302.description: United States Code, Title 46 (Shipping); Chapter 803 (Ice And Derelicts). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) General Requirements.— Unless the agreements made under section 80301 of this title provide otherwise, an ice patrol shall be maintained during the entire ice season in guarding the southeastern, southern, and southwestern limits of the region of icebergs in the vicinity of the Grand Banks.
